about: Golden vectors of the bind: the binding of one seat (bind), the dispatch explain answer (explain), the pre-admission facts (preflight), the seat config slice and its digest (seatConfig) and effective rigor (effectiveRigor), recorded from the Node functions that answer them today by scripts/executor-model-vectors.mjs. A vector is { name, fact, runner, machine?, args, leaseRead?, decided?, expect }. runner is the effective runner section; machine describes the machine as in executor-model.v1.json (accountState is the lease state document); args are the ask, session, walk, accounts (present: the bind reads lease state; assignmentId names the assignment) and now; leaseRead is what Dispatch's adapter reads from the lease state, keyed by the document's provider keys, the account state a binder that takes it as an input is handed; expect is the answer, a thrown error being { error: { name, code?, message } }. A binding's bindingInput leaves out hostVersion (the route's). A vector marked decided states a rule decided after the Node bind was written: its expect is written by hand and the script never records it. The doc is docs/platform/runner/contracts/executor-model.md.
